hero.title: Small by choice. Serious by nature.
hero.subtitle: Wiesmann Software Engineering is a one-person studio — deliberately. Here's why that's good for your project.

story.title: The story
paragraphs: After years of building web and mobile products in teams of all sizes, I founded Wiesmann Software Engineering to work the way I believe great software gets made: one accountable expert, close to the client, from first idea to final deploy.
Based in Switzerland, I work with founders, small businesses and teams who need a senior engineer who also understands branding, SEO and the business side of shipping software.

founder.title: The founder
founder.name: Matthias Wiesmann
founder.bio: Web and mobile developer with experience across the full product lifecycle — from refining rough business ideas into concrete requirements, to designing, building, launching and marketing digital products.

items.title: Ownership
items.description: Your project is never passed down the line. I plan it, build it and stand behind it.

items.title: Clarity
items.description: Plain language, honest estimates, no jargon walls. You always know where things stand.

items.title: Quality
items.description: Fast, accessible, maintainable software. Boring technology where possible, innovation where it counts.

items.title: Partnership
items.description: I succeed when your product succeeds — so I'll challenge ideas that won't work and champion the ones that will.

plus.title: The price advantage
plus.description: No account managers, no office overhead, no agency margin stacked on top. You pay for senior work actually done — not for keeping a big team busy. That makes professional quality noticeably more affordable.

minus.title: The honest trade-off
minus.description: I'm usually deep in one or two client projects, so — emergencies aside — I'm not reachable all day, every day. In return, you'll always know exactly when I'm available and what I'm working on for you right now.

hero.title: Let's talk about your project
hero.subtitle: Whether it's a rough idea or a detailed brief — send me a message and I'll reply within one business day.

web-development.title: Web Development
web-development.metaDescription: Fast, accessible websites and web applications built with modern frameworks like Next.js and React.
web-development.tagline: Websites and web apps that feel instant
web-development.description: From marketing sites to complex web applications — I build fast, accessible, maintainable products with modern tools like Next.js, React and TypeScript.

features.title: Modern stack
features.description: Next.js, React and TypeScript — proven technology that loads fast and ranks well.

features.title: Performance-first
features.description: Core Web Vitals in the green from day one, because speed is a feature.

features.title: Accessible by default
features.description: Semantic HTML and WCAG-minded design so everyone can use your product.

features.title: Easy to maintain
features.description: Clean, documented code you (or any future developer) can actually work with.

process.title: Scope
process.description: We define pages, features and integrations — and cut what's not needed.

process.title: Design
process.description: A clickable design you approve before development starts.

process.title: Build & launch
process.description: Iterative development, then deployment with analytics and SEO baked in.

faq.question: How long does a typical website take?
faq.answer: A focused marketing site usually ships in 3–6 weeks. Larger web applications depend on scope — you'll get an honest estimate after our first call.

faq.question: Can you extend my existing site?
faq.answer: Yes. I regularly take over and modernize existing codebases, and I'll tell you honestly if a rebuild makes more sense.

faq.question: Do you host the site?
faq.answer: I set up hosting on your own accounts (Vercel, Netlify or your own server), so everything stays in your ownership.

mobile-app-development.title: Mobile App Development
mobile-app-development.metaDescription: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single codebase — designed, built and published.
mobile-app-development.description: I build cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android that feel native — from the first wireframe to App Store and Google Play submission.

features.title: Cross-platform efficiency
features.description: One codebase for iOS and Android keeps costs down and quality up.

features.title: Native feel
features.description: Smooth animations, platform conventions and offline-first behavior where it matters.

features.title: Store-ready
features.description: I handle signing, screenshots and the submission process for both stores.

features.title: Backend included
features.description: APIs, push notifications, auth and data sync — the full package, not just the UI.

process.title: Validate
process.description: We sharpen the core use case your app must nail — and drop the rest.

process.title: Prototype
process.description: A testable build on real devices within weeks, not months.

process.title: Ship & iterate
process.description: Store submission, then measured improvements based on real usage.

faq.question: Native or cross-platform?
faq.answer: For most business apps, cross-platform (e.g. React Native / Flutter) is the pragmatic choice. If your app truly needs native, I'll say so.

faq.question: How much does an app cost?
faq.answer: A focused MVP typically starts in the mid five-figure range. After a free scoping call you'll get a fixed, honest estimate.

faq.question: Do you maintain apps after launch?
faq.answer: Yes — I offer maintenance agreements covering updates, store requirements and new OS versions.

seo.title: SEO
seo.metaDescription: Technical and content SEO that brings the right visitors — audits, on-page optimization and measurable results.
seo.tagline: Be found by the right people
seo.description: SEO is not magic — it's solid technology plus useful content. I audit, fix and optimize so search engines and humans both love your site.

features.title: Technical audit
features.description: Crawlability, indexing, structured data, Core Web Vitals — the full technical picture.

features.title: On-page optimization
features.description: Titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal linking that actually match search intent.

features.title: Content guidance
features.description: Keyword research turned into a realistic content plan you can execute.

features.title: Measurable results
features.description: Rank tracking and analytics setup, so progress is visible — not promised.

process.title: Audit
process.description: A prioritized report: what's broken, what's missing, what to do first.

process.title: Fix
process.description: I implement the technical fixes directly — no agency hand-off.

process.title: Grow
process.description: Content and structure improvements, tracked month over month.

faq.question: How long until SEO shows results?
faq.answer: Technical fixes can show effects in weeks; content-driven growth typically takes 3–6 months. Anyone promising page one overnight is selling you something.

faq.question: Do you offer one-time audits?
faq.answer: Yes — a one-time technical audit with a clear, prioritized action list is a great starting point.

faq.question: Is SEO included when you build my site?
faq.answer: Every site I build ships with technical SEO fundamentals included. Ongoing SEO work is a separate engagement.

branding.title: Branding
branding.metaDescription: Logos, colors, typography and design systems that make your product recognizable and consistent.
branding.description: Your product deserves more than a default template look. I create focused brand identities — logo, colors, typography and a design system that scales from business card to app.

features.title: Logo & mark
features.description: A distinctive logo with variants for app icons, favicons and social profiles.

features.title: Color & typography
features.description: A considered palette and type pairing that work in print and on screen.

features.title: Design system
features.description: Reusable components and tokens, so your brand stays consistent as you grow.

features.title: Brand guidelines
features.description: A compact, practical guide — not a 90-page PDF nobody reads.

process.title: Discover
process.description: What should people feel when they meet your brand? We define it in words first.

process.title: Explore
process.description: Two to three visual directions, refined together with your feedback.

process.title: Systemize
process.description: The chosen direction becomes a complete, usable brand kit.

faq.question: I only need a logo — is that possible?
faq.answer: Yes, though most clients benefit from at least colors and typography too. We'll scope it to what you actually need.

faq.question: Can you rebrand an existing product?
faq.answer: Absolutely. I can evolve an existing identity carefully instead of starting from zero.

faq.question: Do I own the brand assets?
faq.answer: Yes. You receive all source files and full usage rights.

consulting.title: Business & Technical Consulting
consulting.metaDescription: Turn a rough business idea into a concrete, buildable product plan — technical strategy, architecture and honest advice.
consulting.tagline: From rough idea to real plan
consulting.description: You have an idea — but what should it actually become, and what will it take to build? I help you refine business ideas into concrete product plans with realistic scope, technology choices and budgets.

features.title: Idea refinement
features.description: Workshops that turn 'wouldn't it be cool if…' into a sharp, testable product concept.

features.title: Technical strategy
features.description: Architecture and technology choices that fit your budget and team — not just the hype.

features.title: Roadmap & estimation
features.description: A realistic plan: what to build first, what it costs, and what can wait.

features.title: Second opinion
features.description: An independent senior review of quotes, architectures or existing code.

process.title: Listen
process.description: I dig into your goals, constraints and the market you're entering.

process.title: Analyze
process.description: Options and trade-offs, explained in plain language.

process.title: Plan
process.description: You leave with a concrete document you can act on — with me or any other team.

faq.question: I'm not technical — is this for me?
faq.answer: Especially then. My job is to translate between your business and the technology it needs.

faq.question: Do you also build what you plan?
faq.answer: Often, yes — but there's no obligation. The plan is yours to keep either way.

faq.question: How does consulting get billed?
faq.answer: Workshops and reviews are billed at a fixed day rate, agreed upfront. No surprise invoices.
